notes: Mode-A CONTRACT eval for structure_recent_news_json (llm_evals_plan PR 4). Live web output can't be pinned to an expected value, so each case grades the prompt's own HARD RULES as code-checked invariants over whatever rows come back: every row is an object with non-empty headline + http(s) url + 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' published_at + tz in {UTC, ET} + non-future date + non-empty source. An empty array is a PASS ('no determinable news' is a valid answer). Cases cost real web-search spend (Opus + capped web budget) — keep the set small.
